transformations: discarded rows containing detected email addresses, phone numbers, URLs, names, account-like identifiers, or unclear text
removed source request IDs, exact addresses, coordinates, postcodes, and other street-level fields
kept only a ward or community-area location and marked exact_location as missing
lightly edited spelling, repetition, and location wording without adding complaint facts
manually assigned labels and checked every retained complaint against schema version 1.0

privacy_review.raw_storage: temporary local audit only; removed after curation

limitations: the public training slice covers electricity, roads and streetlights, sanitation and waste, and water supply only
the external slice covers roads, streetlights, drainage, and waste only
the source category mapping is a manual project annotation, not an official label supplied by either source
the derived wording is not a verbatim archive of the source record
